newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak 1996 Jan-Sept GDP up 7.0 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Slovak 1996 Jan-Sept GDP up 7.0 pct y/y.

text.p: Slovak real gross domestic product rose 7.0 percent in the first nine months of 1996 compared with 6.5-percent year-on-year growth in the January-September period of 1995, the Slovak Statistical Bureau (SUSR) said on Thursday.
SUSR said the country's GDP grew by 6.9 percent in the third quarter of this year compared with an 8.2-percent increase in the third quarter of 1995.
